notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Nadier.
description:
Activate Nadier by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Nadier's leaves-the-battlefield and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability each trigger.
Resolve the Nadier trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Nadier.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Elf Warrior tokens, adding {1}{U}.
The tokens leave the battlefield, triggering Nadier's first ability twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Nadier.
Repeat.
